description: Update the tower-http dependency to address deprecation warnings in the codebase. This involves upgrading to a newer version of tower-http and making necessary adjustments to the routing and handler modules to maintain compatibility while eliminating deprecated API usage.
functional_requirements: Upgrade the tower-http dependency to a version that resolves the deprecation warnings
Update any routing code that uses deprecated tower-http APIs to use their modern equivalents
Ensure handler functionality remains unchanged after the dependency update
Verify that all existing tests continue to pass with the updated dependency
